title: Hugh Angleton in Italy during the 1933 Magenta crash

tellings.quote: was actually stationed um in Italy at the time or his father was Hugh Engleton at the time of the Magenta crash in 1933, which is really crazy.

plain: Michels points out that Hugh Angleton, father of the senior CIA officer James Jesus Angleton, was stationed in Italy in 1933, at the time of the Magenta crash, a reported crash of an unknown craft near the Italian town of Magenta. Michels raises this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation with the UFO historian Richard Dolan, and calls it "really crazy". The point of telling it is the hint that the Angleton family may have been near the first known crashed-craft story.
